eligibility_conditions: The applicant must be a domicile of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant must be a female student enrolled in Class 11 or Class 12 in a recognised government school.
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per annum.
Age of the applicant must be between 15 and 19 years as of 1st January 2026.
The applicant must not be receiving scholarship benefits from any other state-funded scheme simultaneously.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of the applicant (linked with active mobile number).
Valid Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar / competent authority.
Bonafide Student Certificate issued by the Head of the Institution.
Bank Passbook copy showing active DBT-enabled account.
doc_1_english_circular.txt.how_to_apply: Applicants must submit their applications online through the official portal at https://wcd.mp.gov.in/balika-protsahan. Offline applications submitted to the District Programme Officer (DPO) will also be accepted at block-level Seva Kendras.

eligibility_conditions: आवेदक उत्तर प्रदेश का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए।
आवेदक के पास अधिकतम 2 हेक्टेयर (5 एकड़) कृषि योग्य भूमि का स्वामित्व होना चाहिए।
आवेदक किसान के परिवार में कोई सदस्य आयकर दाता अथवा सरकारी सेवा में कार्यरत नहीं होना चाहिए।
आवेदक की न्यूनतम आयु 18 वर्ष पूर्ण होनी चाहिए।
documents_required: खतौनी / भू-स्वामित्व प्रमाण पत्र (राजस्व विभाग द्वारा सत्यापित)
doc_2_hindi_circular.txt.how_to_apply: इच्छुक किसान कृषि विभाग के आधिकारिक पोर्टल https://upagriculture.up.gov.in पर जाकर ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं अथवा नजदीकी जन सेवा केंद्र (CSC) के माध्यम से आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

doc_4_scanned_noisy_ocr.txt.scheme_name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Samman Pension Yojana
doc_4_scanned_noisy_ocr.txt.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
doc_4_scanned_noisy_ocr.txt.benefit_amount: Monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 per month for beneficiaries aged 55 to 74 years, and Rs. 1,250 per month for beneficiaries aged 75 years and above
eligibility_conditions: Women aged 55 years or older; Men aged 58 years or older.
Total combined family annual income must not exceed Rs. 48,000/- per annum.
Persons with no family support or having destitute status.
documents_required: Income self-declaration certificate attested by Patwari/Sarpanch
doc_4_scanned_noisy_ocr.txt.how_to_apply: Apply online through Emitra kiosks or RajSSP portal at https://rajssp.raj.nic.in.
doc_4_scanned_noisy_ocr.txt.deadline: No last date for application (Open throughout the year)
